summary: Frozen Stucco 0.2.1 analysis used to exercise the CI action without a provider call. This fixture covers semantic page rendering only.

findings.title: Use Page::main for the main landmark and skip link
findings.guidance: Compose a page with Page::new(&bundle, title).main(content).render(). Enable layout and typography for the components in this example. Page::main supplies the main landmark and skip link.

recipes.title: Render a semantic page
recipes.description: Render a complete Stucco document with escaped text, a main landmark, and a skip link. This example checks the HTML string; it does not serve or export theme assets.
